headlines.title: Supreme Court rejects Missouri’s attempt to use newly drawn Republican congressional map
headlines.description: The Supreme Court has rejected an attempt for Missouri to use a congressional map drawn by Republicans that would have likely eliminated the seat of a Democratic incumbent. NBC News' Sahil Kapur reports on the decision and the last-ditch attempt Republicans had taken to use the new map.

headlines.title: AI researcher says there is 'substantial probability' AI could kill all humans in next decade
headlines.description: Former AI researcher for Anthropic and Open AI, Jacob Coxon, talked to NBC News' Tom Llamas about his viral tweet where he stated AI could "kill us all" by the end of the next decade. Coxon spoke about why he resigned from Anthropic, how AI advancements are creating major concerns and what could be done about it.

headlines.title: Sons of 9/11 firefighter grew up to carry on their father's legacy
headlines.description: Twenty-five years after losing their father — FDNY firefighter Frank Palombo — on 9/11, the Palombo family reflects on grief, community support and a legacy carried forward. NBC News' Gary Grumbach reports.

headlines.title: Hillary Clinton warns the U.S. has let its guard down on terrorism 25 years after 9/11
headlines.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton warned Thursday that the Trump administration isn’t doing enough to monitor and thwart terrorists who still pose a threat to the U.S., 25 years after the 9/11 attacks.

headlines.title: ‘We felt defeated’: Lindsay Clancy juror provides new details about the lone holdout
headlines.description: A juror in Lindsay Clancy’s murder trial provided new details Thursday about the lone holdout on the panel, including that he acted out the killings on a water bottle during deliberations.

headlines.title: Spice Girls fans feel duped after social media tease wasn’t for tour, but a music re-release
headlines.description: Spice Girls fans are telling you what they want — what they really, really want — and it’s a tour that they aren’t getting any time soon.

headlines.title: Hurricane carves path of destruction in Hawaii
headlines.description: More than 80% of customers are without power on the island of Kauai after Hurricane Lowell left a path of destruction. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz is in the storm zone tonight.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Heart damage may occur from getting too much light at night while we sleep, study finds
headlines.description: Too much light exposure during sleep may lead to potentially harmful changes in the structure and function of the heart, a new study suggests.

headlines.title: CDC warns of a summer spike in rabies exposures
headlines.description: A spike in exposures to rabies across the U.S. this summer has prompted the CDC to issue a health alert.

headlines.title: The political risk behind Trump’s $5,000 pledge: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Jonathan Allen digs into President Donald Trump’s latest promise to voters.
